versions.changelog:
- Removed the file: skill-card.md.
- Updated outline format to use an OutlineModel object, with "main_title" and "narrative" fields, instead of a plain array.
- Updated params.json structure to match the new OutlineModel format.
- No functional or workflow changes to the PPT generation steps.

- Initial release of kejian365-aippt: generate professional PPT presentations via the 课件帮 AI platform.
- Automates the entire workflow: gathers user requirements, creates an outline, selects a suitable template, generates content and layout, and delivers a preview link.
- Supports common presentation scenarios: business reports, product introductions, academic presentations, and training materials.
- Fully script-driven; no manual API calls required.
- Includes robust error handling and progress reporting throughout the process.
